summary: In the lobby, the elevator reaches the bottom of its drop, then a massive explosion detonates: the blast blows the elevator doors open and fire clouds engulf the elevator section of the lobby.

what_changes.before: Has hit the bottom of the shaft intact, doors shut.
what_changes.after: Blown open by an explosion, its section of the lobby engulfed in fire.
what_changes.evidence: The massive explosion blows open the doors, fire clouds engulfing the elevator section of the lobby.

event_hint.one_line: Neo and Trinity's elevator bomb detonates in the lobby.

uncertain: Whether anyone is inside or near the elevator at the moment of the blast; the scene names no people.
